title: engine: `resolveSearchFields` falls back to the whole default set when every requested search field is unknown, where the doors refuse `INVALID_FIELD`
body:
domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czVnUdQQCVKSW5J2uk

Filing gate: ① contract review of PR #28108 (#27732), should-fix S3 (record 6523659371), from the dev's "noted, not filed" item (os-dev report 6523412292). Filed by `domain:server` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade.

Reach: an in-process caller (host handler, flow, hook) whose `searchFields` override names only fields outside the object's searchable set — a typo, or a field that was renamed. The search silently runs over the default set instead of being refused.
Reader who acts: `domain:server` (`packages/objectql`).

## What the code does (read, not measured)

`resolveSearchFields` (`packages/objectql/src/search-fields.ts` ~L263-273) drops unknown names and, when none remain, falls back to the whole allowed set. The REST door refuses the same value with `400 INVALID_FIELD`. The dev calls it the search twin of #27165. PR #28108 closed the empty-list half of the same tolerance; this is the all-unknown half.

## Wanted (route is triage's)

The engine refuses an override that names no searchable field, in the door's shape (`INVALID_FIELD`), as #28108 did for the empty list. Expected `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`.

## Dedupe

Read the open titles for `searchFields`, `resolveSearchFields`, unknown search field, `INVALID_FIELD` search: none. #27165 is the non-search twin. **New.**

Links back: #27732, PR #28108, #27165
